source: Unchanged Japanese Random Forest mask; 13 October 2019 retrospective detection
method: Area totals count native 10 m UTM pixel centres inside the padded crop-study rectangle. Footprint is nearest-neighbour reprojected to Web Mercator for display. Covers all land, not just paddies.
limitations: Not an independently validated flood boundary; classification errors and permanent water may be present.
Grey means unknown or outside raster coverage; transparent means no flood detected, not proven dry.
All-land footprint hectares differ from area-weighted parcel flooded hectares.
